status: documentary starter entries; not the deployed BMS import schema or executable pump commands
scope: original ADP, not ADP Detect; source variants are exact points, not universal ranges
defaulting_policy: Only unspecified applicable fields inherit defined Water values for the exact matching context; record before Run and in method log without an extra gate. An absent source value remains absent. No unsupported operation becomes applied by substitution.
selection_policy: explicit tip/filter/mode/volume/context variant; no interpolation or scaling implied

p8-segmented.text: Some dispenses have been split into “First Dispense” and “Final Dispense” to maximize pipetting performance.

p7-method.text: Aspirate blowout volume of air; aspirate corrected volume of sample; aspirate carry volume of air; zero balance; dispense carry, sample and blowout volumes and record mass. Clean DiTi with each dispense, 12 data points per value; two successive runs with the same ADP. ADP on Cavro Omni Robot; LiHa unfiltered tips; Mettler-Toledo balance 0.01 mg resolution with evaporation trap; temperature 21–25°C (uncontrolled).

p8-limitations.text: These data were collected under controlled conditions as a guideline for pump module performance. Pump performance is only one element of system level liquid handling results. Always handle sample liquids with appropriate care. DMSO is extremely hygroscopic, limit exposure to atmosphere.

p8-accuracy.text: Point Accuracy (A) is deviation of each data point from the average of the group; maximum value for each data set is presented. A = |xavg − xi| / xavg * 100%; CV = standard deviation / average. This is not mean delivery bias relative to the requested target.

p6-method.text: Aspirate 10 μl blowout air, corrected sample volume, then 2 μl carry air. Dispense carry, sample and blowout. Gravimetric samples ≥20 μl; colorimetric samples <20 μl. All dispenses non-contact except 1 μl. 1 μl contact dispense includes 4.575 μl conditioning volume. Artel MVS colorimetric system is additional to the balance setup.

p6-replication.text: Each data point is the average value for 5 pumps, with 12 data points per pump per dispense volume. The separate 100 multi row and its multi-dispense footnote are excluded from these single-dispense records.

null_convention: null means not reported or printed dash as explicitly tagged; a printed dash is preserved and never converted to numeric zero. No numeric zero occurs in page 8 recipe cells.
